notes.A: The junction and tower establish the setting, but the side street disappears into black.
notes.B: Low masonry and fiery sky frame the street, but a foreground lamp blocks the junction.
notes.C: A brick corner frames the open square, but the paving swallows its edges.
notes.D: Rows of windows and a doorway face a lane that fades into shadow.
notes.E: The view links the square to the street, but a blank wall dominates the foreground.
notes.F: The brick corner, lamps, and fiery skyline define the square, whose center feels empty.
notes.G: Parallel sidewalks lead between the tower and brick block toward a barely visible end.
notes.H: The doorway and narrow lane suggest a destination, but the foreground lamp dominates.

avenue.place: Lamplit crossroads in a hellish city
avenue.best: The elevated view ties together the cobbled junction, streetlamps, stone tower, brick blocks, and burning sky.
avenue.lacks: The square has no recognizable destination. Repeated windows, paving, and lamps give the streets a consistent look but little identity at ground level.
avenue.fix: Build a damaged stone fountain in the square, with a lamp at its base to make it recognizable from the adjoining streets.

blind_name.name: Gothic city intersection
blind_name.why: Cobblestone streets meet between brick buildings, with glowing streetlamps under a red sky.
blind_name.odd: The street in the distance fades into near-total darkness.

notes.A: A high view down the narrow street reduces the station to cropped lettering.
notes.B: The entrance and glowing plaques read clearly. The steep angle compresses the street frontage.
notes.C: The streetlamp and opposite doors define the forecourt. The station entrance falls outside the frame.
notes.D: A close view shows the recessed entrance and plaques. The station name starts offscreen.
notes.E: The green lettering dominates the wall. The elevated view crops out the entrance.
notes.F: The oblique view connects the sign to the side street. The entrance slips below frame.
notes.G: The signed entrance and forecourt share the frame. The recess is almost black.
notes.H: The higher view opens up the forecourt. The entrance blends into the paving and shadow.

station_front.best: G shows the station name, recessed entrance, and lamplit forecourt together, with the opposite building framing the approach.
station_front.lacks: The station lacks a recognizable public entrance. Its doorway is swallowed by shadow and repeated masonry, leaving the lettering to establish the building’s purpose.
station_front.fix: Add a lit canopy over the entrance, projecting into the forecourt so the station has a recognizable threshold from across the street.

blind_name.name: Dark cobblestone courtyard
blind_name.why: Tall masonry facades with rows of windows surround a paved open area.
blind_name.odd: The right-hand passage is nearly black, and small eye symbols line the walls.
